from langflow.base.data.utils import TEXT_FILE_TYPES, parallel_load_data, parse_text_file_to_data, retrieve_file_paths
from langflow.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from langflow.io import BoolInput, IntInput, MessageTextInput, MultiselectInput
from langflow.schema.data import Data
from langflow.schema.dataframe import DataFrame
from langflow.template.field.base import Output


class DirectoryComponent(Component):
    display_name = "Directory"
    description = "Recursively load files from a directory."
    documentation: str = "https://docs.langflow.org/components-data#directory"
    icon = "folder"
    name = "Directory"

    inputs = [
        MessageTextInput(
            name="path",
            display_name="Path",
            info="Path to the directory to load files from. Defaults to current directory ('.')",
            value=".",
            tool_mode=True,
        ),
        MultiselectInput(
            name="types",
            display_name="File Types",
            info="File types to load. Select one or more types or leave empty to load all supported types.",
            options=TEXT_FILE_TYPES,
            value=[],
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="depth",
            display_name="Depth",
            info="Depth to search for files.",
            value=0,
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="max_concurrency",
            display_name="Max Concurrency",
            advanced=True,
            info="Maximum concurrency for loading files.",
            value=2,
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="load_hidden",
            display_name="Load Hidden",
            advanced=True,
            info="If true, hidden files will be loaded.",
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="recursive",
            display_name="Recursive",
            advanced=True,
            info="If true, the search will be recursive.",
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="silent_errors",
            display_name="Silent Errors",
            advanced=True,
            info="If true, errors will not raise an exception.",
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="use_multithreading",
            display_name="Use Multithreading",
            advanced=True,
            info="If true, multithreading will be used.",
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Loaded Files", name="dataframe", method="as_dataframe"),
    ]

    def load_directory(self) -> list[Data]:
        path = self.path
        types = self.types
        depth = self.depth
        max_concurrency = self.max_concurrency
        load_hidden = self.load_hidden
        recursive = self.recursive
        silent_errors = self.silent_errors
        use_multithreading = self.use_multithreading

        resolved_path = self.resolve_path(path)

        # If no types are specified, use all supported types
        if not types:
            types = TEXT_FILE_TYPES

        # Check if all specified types are valid
        invalid_types = [t for t in types if t not in TEXT_FILE_TYPES]
        if invalid_types:
            msg = f"Invalid file types specified: {invalid_types}. Valid types are: {TEXT_FILE_TYPES}"
            raise ValueError(msg)

        valid_types = types

        file_paths = retrieve_file_paths(
            resolved_path, load_hidden=load_hidden, recursive=recursive, depth=depth, types=valid_types
        )

        loaded_data = []
        if use_multithreading:
            loaded_data = parallel_load_data(file_paths, silent_errors=silent_errors, max_concurrency=max_concurrency)
        else:
            loaded_data = [parse_text_file_to_data(file_path, silent_errors=silent_errors) for file_path in file_paths]

        valid_data = [x for x in loaded_data if x is not None and isinstance(x, Data)]
        self.status = valid_data
        return valid_data

    def as_dataframe(self) -> DataFrame:
        return DataFrame(self.load_directory())

from langflow.custom import Component
from langflow.io import DataInput, Output, MessageTextInput
from langflow.schema import Data
import os

class FileRouterEnricher(Component):
    display_name = "File Router Enricher"
    description = "Unpacks JSONL results and tags data with 'route_key' based on file extension."
    icon = "network_check"
    name = "FileRouterEnricher"

    inputs = [
        DataInput(
            name="input_data",
            display_name="Input Data",
            info="JSONL Data containing 'results' list with 'file_path'.",
            required=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="mapping_config",
            display_name="Extension Mapping",
            info="Format: ext: route_key (e.g., md: markdown, py: code)",
            value=(
                "md: markdown, "
                "py: code, ts: code, go: code, cs: code, json: code, sql: code, "
                "csv: spreadsheet, xlsx: spreadsheet, "
                "txt: document, docx: document, "
                "pdf: pdf, png: image, jpg: image"
            ),
            tool_mode=True,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Enriched Data", name="output_data", method="process_data"),
    ]

    def process_data(self) -> list[Data]:
        # 1. Parse Mapping Config
        ext_map = {}
        try:
            pairs = self.mapping_config.split(',')
            for p in pairs:
                if ':' in p:
                    k, v = p.split(':', 1)
                    ext_map[k.strip().lower()] = v.strip().lower()
        except Exception:
            pass

        # 2. Prepare Data Processing
        input_list = self.input_data if isinstance(self.input_data, list) else [self.input_data]
        final_docs = []

        for doc in input_list:
            # --- Handle Nested JSON Structure (The Fix) ---
            # ตามตัวอย่างของคุณ ข้อมูลจริงอยู่ใน metadata['results'] เป็น list
            items_to_process = []
            
            # Case A: Nested Structure (จาก JSONL)
            if isinstance(doc.data, dict) and "results" in doc.data and isinstance(doc.data["results"], list):
                items_to_process = doc.data["results"]
            # Case B: Flat Structure (เผื่อไฟล์อื่นมาแบบปกติ)
            else:
                items_to_process = [doc.data]

            for item in items_to_process:
                # สร้าง Metadata ใหม่
                new_metadata = item.copy() if isinstance(item, dict) else {}
                
                # หา File Path
                file_path = new_metadata.get("file_path") or new_metadata.get("source", "")
                
                # หา Text Content (สำคัญมากสำหรับการ Splitter ต่อไป)
                text_content = new_metadata.get("text") or new_metadata.get("page_content", "")
                
                # --- LOGIC: กำหนด Route Key ---
                route_key = "unknown"
                extension = ""
                
                if file_path:
                    _, ext = os.path.splitext(file_path)
                    extension = ext.lstrip('.').lower()
                    # Map นามสกุล -> Route Key
                    route_key = ext_map.get(extension, "unknown")

                # --- LOGIC: เดา Department (Optional) ---
                # เราใช้ Path มาช่วยระบุที่มา
                department = "General"
                path_lower = file_path.lower()
                if "rag md" in path_lower or "dev" in path_lower or "source" in path_lower:
                    department = "Developer"
                elif "qa" in path_lower or "test" in path_lower:
                    department = "QA-Tester"
                elif "business" in path_lower or "req" in path_lower:
                    department = "Business"
                elif "ux" in path_lower or "ui" in path_lower:
                    department = "UX/UI"

                # Update Metadata
                new_metadata["doc_extension"] = extension
                new_metadata["route_key"] = route_key # ใช้ค่านี้ใน Router Node
                new_metadata["department"] = department

                # สร้าง Data Object ใหม่
                # สำคัญ: ต้องใส่ text ลงไปตรงๆ เพื่อให้ Splitter Node ถัดไปมองเห็น
                new_data = Data(
                    text=text_content, 
                    data=new_metadata
                )
                final_docs.append(new_data)

        self.status = f"Processed {len(final_docs)} items. Routes found: {set(d.data['route_key'] for d in final_docs)}"
        return final_docs

from typing import Any

from langflow.custom import Component
from langflow.io import HandleInput, Output, TabInput
from langflow.schema import Data, DataFrame, Message


def convert_to_message(v) -> Message:
    """Convert input to Message type.

    Args:
        v: Input to convert (Message, Data, DataFrame, or dict)

    Returns:
        Message: Converted Message object
    """
    return v if isinstance(v, Message) else v.to_message()


def convert_to_data(v: DataFrame | Data | Message | dict) -> Data:
    """Convert input to Data type.

    Args:
        v: Input to convert (Message, Data, DataFrame, or dict)

    Returns:
        Data: Converted Data object
    """
    if isinstance(v, dict):
        return Data(v)
    if isinstance(v, Message):
        return v.to_data()
    return v if isinstance(v, Data) else v.to_data()


def convert_to_dataframe(v: DataFrame | Data | Message | dict) -> DataFrame:
    """Convert input to DataFrame type.

    Args:
        v: Input to convert (Message, Data, DataFrame, or dict)

    Returns:
        DataFrame: Converted DataFrame object
    """
    if isinstance(v, dict):
        return DataFrame([v])
    return v if isinstance(v, DataFrame) else v.to_dataframe()


class TypeConverterComponent(Component):
    display_name = "Type Convert"
    description = "Convert between different types (Message, Data, DataFrame)"
    documentation: str = "https://docs.langflow.org/components-processing#type-convert"
    icon = "repeat"

    inputs = [
        HandleInput(
            name="input_data",
            display_name="Input",
            input_types=["Message", "Data", "DataFrame"],
            info="Accept Message, Data or DataFrame as input",
            required=True,
        ),
        TabInput(
            name="output_type",
            display_name="Output Type",
            options=["Message", "Data", "DataFrame"],
            info="Select the desired output data type",
            real_time_refresh=True,
            value="Message",
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(
            display_name="Message Output",
            name="message_output",
            method="convert_to_message",
        )
    ]

    def update_outputs(self, frontend_node: dict, field_name: str, field_value: Any) -> dict:
        """Dynamically show only the relevant output based on the selected output type."""
        if field_name == "output_type":
            # Start with empty outputs
            frontend_node["outputs"] = []

            # Add only the selected output type
            if field_value == "Message":
                frontend_node["outputs"].append(
                    Output(
                        display_name="Message Output",
                        name="message_output",
                        method="convert_to_message",
                    ).to_dict()
                )
            elif field_value == "Data":
                frontend_node["outputs"].append(
                    Output(
                        display_name="Data Output",
                        name="data_output",
                        method="convert_to_data",
                    ).to_dict()
                )
            elif field_value == "DataFrame":
                frontend_node["outputs"].append(
                    Output(
                        display_name="DataFrame Output",
                        name="dataframe_output",
                        method="convert_to_dataframe",
                    ).to_dict()
                )

        return frontend_node

    def convert_to_message(self) -> Message:
        """Convert input to Message type."""
        input_value = self.input_data[0] if isinstance(self.input_data, list) else self.input_data

        # Handle string input by converting to Message first
        if isinstance(input_value, str):
            input_value = Message(text=input_value)

        result = convert_to_message(input_value)
        self.status = result
        return result

    def convert_to_data(self) -> Data:
        """Convert input to Data type."""
        input_value = self.input_data[0] if isinstance(self.input_data, list) else self.input_data

        # Handle string input by converting to Message first
        if isinstance(input_value, str):
            input_value = Message(text=input_value)

        result = convert_to_data(input_value)
        self.status = result
        return result

    def convert_to_dataframe(self) -> DataFrame:
        """Convert input to DataFrame type."""
        input_value = self.input_data[0] if isinstance(self.input_data, list) else self.input_data

        # Handle string input by converting to Message first
        if isinstance(input_value, str):
            input_value = Message(text=input_value)

        result = convert_to_dataframe(input_value)
        self.status = result
        return result

from langflow.custom import Component
from langflow.io import DataInput, Output, MessageTextInput, BoolInput
from langflow.schema import Data
from langchain_text_splitters import MarkdownHeaderTextSplitter

class MarkdownHeaderSplitter(Component):
    display_name = "Markdown Header Splitter"
    description = "Splits markdown text by headers (H1, H2, H3) handling nested 'results' structure."
    icon = "Markdown"
    name = "MarkdownHeaderSplitter"

    inputs = [
        DataInput(
            name="input_data",
            display_name="Input Data",
            info="The data containing 'results' list or direct text.",
            required=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="headers_map",
            display_name="Headers to Split On",
            info="Example: #: H1, ##: H2, ###: H3",
            value="#: H1, ##: H2, ###: H3",
            tool_mode=True,
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="strip_headers",
            display_name="Strip Headers",
            value=False,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Split Data", name="output_data", method="split_markdown"),
    ]

    def split_markdown(self) -> list[Data]:
        # 1. Parse Headers Config
        headers_to_split_on = []
        try:
            raw_headers = self.headers_map.split(",")
            for item in raw_headers:
                if ":" in item:
                    key, val = item.split(":", 1)
                    headers_to_split_on.append((key.strip(), val.strip()))
        except Exception:
            headers_to_split_on = [("#", "Header 1"), ("##", "Header 2"), ("###", "Header 3")]

        markdown_splitter = MarkdownHeaderTextSplitter(
            headers_to_split_on=headers_to_split_on,
            strip_headers=self.strip_headers
        )

        final_docs = []
        
        # แปลง input ให้เป็น list เสมอ
        input_list = self.input_data if isinstance(self.input_data, list) else [self.input_data]

        for doc in input_list:
            # --- ส่วนที่แก้ไข (FIXED LOGIC) ---
            
            # เตรียมรายการข้อมูลที่จะนำมา Split
            items_to_process = []
            
            # กรณี 1: โครงสร้างแบบที่คุณส่งมา (มี key "results" เป็น list)
            if isinstance(doc.data, dict) and "results" in doc.data and isinstance(doc.data["results"], list):
                items_to_process = doc.data["results"] # ดึง list ข้างในออกมา
            
            # กรณี 2: โครงสร้างปกติ (ไม่มี results)
            elif isinstance(doc.data, dict):
                items_to_process = [doc.data] # ใช้ data ก้อนนั้นเลย
            
            # เริ่มวนลูปข้อมูลจริงๆ
            for item in items_to_process:
                # หา text ให้เจอ ไม่ว่าจะชื่อ 'text' หรือ 'page_content'
                text_content = item.get("text") or item.get("page_content")
                
                if not text_content:
                    continue # ถ้าไม่มี text ก็ข้าม

                # ทำการ Split Text
                splits = markdown_splitter.split_text(text_content)

                # สร้าง Output Data
                for split in splits:
                    # Copy Metadata เดิมมา (เช่น file_path)
                    combined_metadata = item.copy()
                    
                    # ลบ text ก้อนใหญ่ทิ้งไป เพื่อไม่ให้หนัก
                    combined_metadata.pop("text", None)
                    combined_metadata.pop("page_content", None)
                    
                    # เพิ่ม Metadata ใหม่จาก Header (H1, H2)
                    combined_metadata.update(split.metadata)

                    # สร้าง Data object ใหม่
                    new_data = Data(
                        text=split.page_content,
                        data=combined_metadata
                    )
                    final_docs.append(new_data)
                    
        self.status = final_docs
        return final_docs

from google.ai.generativelanguage_v1beta.types import BatchEmbedContentsRequest
from langchain_core.embeddings import Embeddings
from langchain_google_genai import GoogleGenerativeAIEmbeddings
from langchain_google_genai._common import GoogleGenerativeAIError

from langflow.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from langflow.io import MessageTextInput, Output, SecretStrInput

MIN_DIMENSION_ERROR = "Output dimensionality must be at least 1"
MAX_DIMENSION_ERROR = (
    "Output dimensionality cannot exceed 768. Google's embedding models only support dimensions up to 768."
)
MAX_DIMENSION = 768
MIN_DIMENSION = 1


class GoogleGenerativeAIEmbeddingsComponent(Component):
    display_name = "Google Generative AI Embeddings"
    description = (
        "Connect to Google's generative AI embeddings service using the GoogleGenerativeAIEmbeddings class, "
        "found in the langchain-google-genai package."
    )
    documentation: str = "https://python.langchain.com/v0.2/docs/integrations/text_embedding/google_generative_ai/"
    icon = "GoogleGenerativeAI"
    name = "Google Generative AI Embeddings"

    inputs = [
        SecretStrInput(name="api_key", display_name="Google Generative AI API Key", required=True),
        MessageTextInput(name="model_name", display_name="Model Name", value="models/text-embedding-004"),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Embeddings", name="embeddings", method="build_embeddings"),
    ]

    def build_embeddings(self) -> Embeddings:
        if not self.api_key:
            msg = "API Key is required"
            raise ValueError(msg)

        class HotaGoogleGenerativeAIEmbeddings(GoogleGenerativeAIEmbeddings):
            def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs) -> None:
                super(GoogleGenerativeAIEmbeddings, self).__init__(*args, **kwargs)

            def embed_documents(
                self,
                texts: list[str],
                *,
                batch_size: int = 100,
                task_type: str | None = None,
                titles: list[str] | None = None,
                output_dimensionality: int | None = 768,
            ) -> list[list[float]]:
                """Embed a list of strings.

                Google Generative AI currently sets a max batch size of 100 strings.

                Args:
                    texts: List[str] The list of strings to embed.
                    batch_size: [int] The batch size of embeddings to send to the model
                    task_type: task_type (https://ai.google.dev/api/rest/v1/TaskType)
                    titles: An optional list of titles for texts provided.
                    Only applicable when TaskType is RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT.
                    output_dimensionality: Optional reduced dimension for the output embedding.
                    https://ai.google.dev/api/rest/v1/models/batchEmbedContents#EmbedContentRequest
                Returns:
                    List of embeddings, one for each text.
                """
                if output_dimensionality is not None and output_dimensionality < MIN_DIMENSION:
                    raise ValueError(MIN_DIMENSION_ERROR)
                if output_dimensionality is not None and output_dimensionality > MAX_DIMENSION:
                    error_msg = MAX_DIMENSION_ERROR.format(output_dimensionality)
                    raise ValueError(error_msg)

                embeddings: list[list[float]] = []
                batch_start_index = 0
                for batch in GoogleGenerativeAIEmbeddings._prepare_batches(texts, batch_size):
                    if titles:
                        titles_batch = titles[batch_start_index : batch_start_index + len(batch)]
                        batch_start_index += len(batch)
                    else:
                        titles_batch = [None] * len(batch)  # type: ignore[list-item]

                    requests = [
                        self._prepare_request(
                            text=text,
                            task_type=task_type,
                            title=title,
                            output_dimensionality=output_dimensionality,
                        )
                        for text, title in zip(batch, titles_batch, strict=True)
                    ]

                    try:
                        result = self.client.batch_embed_contents(
                            BatchEmbedContentsRequest(requests=requests, model=self.model)
                        )
                    except Exception as e:
                        msg = f"Error embedding content: {e}"
                        raise GoogleGenerativeAIError(msg) from e
                    embeddings.extend([list(e.values) for e in result.embeddings])
                return embeddings

            def embed_query(
                self,
                text: str,
                task_type: str | None = None,
                title: str | None = None,
                output_dimensionality: int | None = 768,
            ) -> list[float]:
                """Embed a text.

                Args:
                    text: The text to embed.
                    task_type: task_type (https://ai.google.dev/api/rest/v1/TaskType)
                    title: An optional title for the text.
                    Only applicable when TaskType is RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT.
                    output_dimensionality: Optional reduced dimension for the output embedding.
                    https://ai.google.dev/api/rest/v1/models/batchEmbedContents#EmbedContentRequest

                Returns:
                    Embedding for the text.
                """

    @override
    @check_cached_vector_store
    def build_vector_store(self) -> Chroma:
        """Builds the Chroma object."""
        try:
            from chromadb import Client
            from langchain_chroma import Chroma
        except ImportError as e:
            msg = "Could not import Chroma integration package. Please install it with `pip install langchain-chroma`."
            raise ImportError(msg) from e
        # Chroma settings
        chroma_settings = None
        client = None
        if self.chroma_server_host:
            chroma_settings = Settings(
                chroma_server_cors_allow_origins=self.chroma_server_cors_allow_origins or [],
                chroma_server_host=self.chroma_server_host,
                chroma_server_http_port=self.chroma_server_http_port or None,
                chroma_server_grpc_port=self.chroma_server_grpc_port or None,
                chroma_server_ssl_enabled=self.chroma_server_ssl_enabled,
            )
            client = Client(settings=chroma_settings)

        # Check persist_directory and expand it if it is a relative path
        persist_directory = self.resolve_path(self.persist_directory) if self.persist_directory is not None else None

        chroma = Chroma(
            persist_directory=persist_directory,
            client=client,
            embedding_function=self.embedding,
            collection_name=self.collection_name,
        )

        self._add_documents_to_vector_store(chroma)
        limit = int(self.limit) if self.limit is not None and str(self.limit).strip() else None
        self.status = chroma_collection_to_data(chroma.get(limit=limit))
        return chroma

    def _add_documents_to_vector_store(self, vector_store: "Chroma") -> None:
        """Adds documents to the Vector Store."""
        ingest_data: list | Data | DataFrame = self.ingest_data
        if not ingest_data:
            self.status = ""
            return

        # Convert DataFrame to Data if needed using parent's method
        ingest_data = self._prepare_ingest_data()

        stored_documents_without_id = []
        if self.allow_duplicates:
            stored_data = []
        else:
            limit = int(self.limit) if self.limit is not None and str(self.limit).strip() else None
            stored_data = chroma_collection_to_data(vector_store.get(limit=limit))
            for value in deepcopy(stored_data):
                del value.id
                stored_documents_without_id.append(value)

        documents = []
        for _input in ingest_data or []:
            if isinstance(_input, Data):
                if _input not in stored_documents_without_id:
                    documents.append(_input.to_lc_document())
            else:
                msg = "Vector Store Inputs must be Data objects."
                raise TypeError(msg)

        if documents and self.embedding is not None:
            self.log(f"Adding {len(documents)} documents to the Vector Store.")
            # Filter complex metadata to prevent ChromaDB errors
            try:
                from langchain_community.vectorstores.utils import filter_complex_metadata

                filtered_documents = filter_complex_metadata(documents)
                vector_store.add_documents(filtered_documents)
            except ImportError:
                self.log("Warning: Could not import filter_complex_metadata. Adding documents without filtering.")
                vector_store.add_documents(documents)
        else:
            self.log("No documents to add to the Vector Store.")

def convert_to_message(v) -> Message:
    """Convert input to Message type.

    Args:

    """
    return v if isinstance(v, Message) else v.to_message()


def convert_to_data(v: DataFrame | Data | Message | dict) -> Data:
    """Convert input to Data type.

    Args:
        v: Input to convert (Message, Data, DataFrame, or dict)

    Returns:
        Data: Converted Data object
    """
    if isinstance(v, dict):

    return v if isinstance(v, Data) else v.to_data()

class FileRouterEnricher(Component):
    display_name = "File Router & Dept Mapper"
    description = "Unpacks data, routes by extension, and maps folders to departments."
    icon = "map"

    inputs = [
        DataInput(

            info="JSONL Data containing 'results' list with 'file_path'.",
            required=True,
        ),
        # 1. Mapping นามสกุล -> Route (สำหรับ Splitter)
        MessageTextInput(
            name="ext_mapping",
            display_name="Extension Mapping (Route)",
            info="Format: ext: route_key",
            value=(
                "md: markdown, "
                "py: code, sql: code, ts: code, go: code, "
                "csv: spreadsheet, xlsx: spreadsheet"
            ),
            tool_mode=True,
        ),
        # 2. Mapping โฟลเดอร์ -> Department (ฟีเจอร์ใหม่ที่คุณต้องการ)
        MessageTextInput(
            name="folder_mapping",
            display_name="Folder Mapping (Department)",
            info="Format: FolderName: Department. Matches if folder name is IN the path.",
            value="RAG DEV: Developer, RAG QA: QA-Tester, RAG BIZ: Business", # ใส่ค่า Default ตามที่คุณยกตัวอย่าง
            tool_mode=True,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Enriched Data", name="output_data", method="process_data"),
    ]

    def process_data(self) -> list[Data]:
        # --- 1. Parse configs ---
        # Parse Extension Mapping
        ext_map = {}
        try:
            for p in self.ext_mapping.split(','):
                if ':' in p:
                    k, v = p.split(':', 1)
                    ext_map[k.strip().lower()] = v.strip().lower()
        except: pass

        # Parse Folder Mapping (ใหม่)
        folder_map = {}
        try:
            for p in self.folder_mapping.split(','):
                if ':' in p:
                    k, v = p.split(':', 1)
                    # เก็บเป็น k: RAG DEV, v: Developer
                    folder_map[k.strip()] = v.strip()
        except: pass

        # --- 2. Process Data ---
        input_list = self.input_data if isinstance(self.input_data, list) else [self.input_data]
        final_docs = []

        for doc in input_list:
            # Handle Nested Structure
            items_to_process = []
            if isinstance(doc.data, dict) and "results" in doc.data and isinstance(doc.data["results"], list):
                items_to_process = doc.data["results"]
            else:
                items_to_process = [doc.data]

            for item in items_to_process:
                new_metadata = item.copy() if isinstance(item, dict) else {}
                
                # ดึงข้อมูลสำคัญ
                file_path = new_metadata.get("file_path") or new_metadata.get("source", "")
                text_content = new_metadata.get("text") or new_metadata.get("page_content", "")
                
                # Logic A: Extension -> Route Key
                route_key = "unknown"
                extension = ""
                if file_path:
                    _, ext = os.path.splitext(file_path)
                    extension = ext.lstrip('.').lower()
                    route_key = ext_map.get(extension, "unknown")

                # Logic B: Folder Name -> Department (ใหม่ ✨)
                # วิธีการทำงาน: เช็คว่าคำว่า "RAG DEV" มีอยู่ใน path "/app/rag_docs/RAG DEV/backend.py" หรือไม่
                department = "General" # ค่า Default
                if file_path:
                    for folder_key, dept_name in folder_map.items():
                        if folder_key in file_path:
                            department = dept_name
                            break # เจอแล้วหยุดเลย

                # Update Metadata
                new_metadata["doc_extension"] = extension
                new_metadata["route_key"] = route_key
                new_metadata["department"] = department # ได้ค่าจาก Folder Mapping แล้ว

                # Create Data Object
                new_data = Data(
                    text=text_content, 
                    data=new_metadata
                )
                final_docs.append(new_data)

        self.status = f"Processed {len(final_docs)} docs. Depts: {set(d.data['department'] for d in final_docs)}"
        return final_docs

                if isinstance(parsed_separators, list):

                    # เพราะ json มาตรฐานจัดการ escape char ให้แล้ว (\n คือ newline)

                    print("Warning: Separators input is not a list.")
                    separators = None
                    
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                print("Error: Invalid JSON format for separators.")
                separators = None
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        return RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter(
            separators=separators,
            chunk_size=self.chunk_size,
            chunk_overlap=self.chunk_overlap,
        )

class SpreadsheetToText(Component):
    display_name = "Spreadsheet to Markdown (Final)"
    description = "Converts Excel/CSV to Markdown and cleans metadata zombies."
    icon = "table"
    name = "SpreadsheetToText"

    inputs = [
        DataInput(
            name="input_data",
            display_name="Input Data",
            required=True,
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="rows_per_chunk",
            display_name="Rows per Chunk",
            value=20,
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="include_index",
            display_name="Include Row Numbers",
            value=False,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Chunked Data", name="output_data", method="process_spreadsheet"),
    ]

    def process_spreadsheet(self) -> list[Data]:
        input_list = self.input_data if isinstance(self.input_data, list) else [self.input_data]
        final_chunks = []

        for doc in input_list:
            file_path = doc.data.get("file_path")
            if not file_path:
                continue

            try:
                # 1. Load DataFrame
                df = None
                if file_path.endswith(".csv"):
                    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, encoding='utf-8')
                elif file_path.endswith(".xlsx") or file_path.endswith(".xls"):
                    df = pd.read_excel(file_path)
                
                if df is not None:
                    # Clean Data
                    df.dropna(how='all', axis=0, inplace=True)
                    df.dropna(how='all', axis=1, inplace=True)
                    df.fillna("", inplace=True)
                    
                    total_rows = len(df)
                    chunk_size = self.rows_per_chunk

                    # 2. Split Loop
                    for start_row in range(0, total_rows, chunk_size):
                        end_row = min(start_row + chunk_size, total_rows)
                        df_chunk = df.iloc[start_row:end_row]
                        
                        # Convert to Markdown (ใช้ tabulate)
                        markdown_text = df_chunk.to_markdown(index=self.include_index)
                        
                        header_context = f"File: {file_path}\nSheet Data (Rows {start_row+1}-{end_row}):\n\n"
                        full_text = header_context + markdown_text

                        # 3. Prepare Metadata & KILL ZOMBIE TEXT 🧟‍♂️
                        new_metadata = doc.data.copy()
                        
                        # --- จุดสำคัญที่สุด (THE FIX) ---
                        if "text" in new_metadata:
                            del new_metadata["text"]  # ลบ Text เก่าทิ้งซะ!
                        # -----------------------------

                        new_metadata["row_start"] = start_row + 1
                        new_metadata["row_end"] = end_row
                        new_metadata["source_type"] = "spreadsheet_chunk"
                        
                        # สร้าง Data ใหม่ด้วย Markdown Table ของจริง
                        chunk_data = Data(
                            text=full_text,
                            data=new_metadata
                        )
                        final_chunks.append(chunk_data)

            except Exception as e:
                # รายงาน Error ถ้ามี
                final_chunks.append(Data(
                    text=f"Error processing {file_path}: {str(e)}",
                    data=doc.data
                ))

        self.status = f"Generated {len(final_chunks)} chunks."
        return final_chunks

from langflow.custom import Component
from langflow.io import DataInput, Output
from langflow.schema import Data
import docx
import os

class DocxToMarkdown(Component):
    display_name = "Docx to Markdown"
    description = "Converts Word documents to Markdown (preserves Headers & Tables)."
    icon = "file-text"
    name = "DocxToMarkdown"

    inputs = [
        DataInput(
            name="input_data",
            display_name="Input Data",
            info="Data containing file_path to .docx",
            required=True,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Markdown Data", name="output_data", method="convert_docx"),
    ]

    def convert_docx(self) -> list[Data]:
        input_list = self.input_data if isinstance(self.input_data, list) else [self.input_data]
        converted_docs = []

        for doc in input_list:
            file_path = doc.data.get("file_path")
            if not file_path or not os.path.exists(file_path):
                continue
            
            # ข้ามถ้าไม่ใช่ .docx
            if not file_path.endswith(".docx"):
                # ถ้าเป็นไฟล์อื่น ให้ส่งผ่านไปเฉยๆ หรือจะ log ก็ได้
                converted_docs.append(doc)
                continue

            try:
                # 1. Load Document
                document = docx.Document(file_path)
                md_lines = []

                # 2. Iterate through elements
                # (python-docx แยก paragraph กับ table คนละ list เราต้องลำดับดีๆ)
                # วิธีง่ายสุดสำหรับ POC คืออ่าน paragraph ก่อน (แต่ table จะไปอยู่ท้าย)
                # วิธีที่ดีกว่าคือ iter_block_items (ต้องใช้ func พิเศษ) 
                # แต่เพื่อความง่ายและเสถียร เราจะใช้วิธีอ่านเรียง Paragraph แล้วแทรก Table ถ้าเจอ
                # (Code นี้เน้นอ่าน Paragraph เป็นหลัก)
                
                for para in document.paragraphs:
                    text = para.text.strip()
                    if not text:
                        continue
                    
                    style_name = para.style.name.lower()
                    
                    # Convert Headings
                    if 'heading 1' in style_name:
                        md_lines.append(f"# {text}")
                    elif 'heading 2' in style_name:
                        md_lines.append(f"\n## {text}")
                    elif 'heading 3' in style_name:
                        md_lines.append(f"\n### {text}")
                    elif 'list' in style_name:
                        md_lines.append(f"- {text}")
                    else:
                        md_lines.append(text)

                # 3. Handle Tables (ต่อท้าย)
                # (Word Table แปลงเป็น Markdown ยากหน่อย แต่นี่คือ Basic Converter)
                if document.tables:
                    md_lines.append("\n\n### Tables Data\n")
                    for table in document.tables:
                        # สร้าง Header Row
                        headers = [cell.text.strip().replace('\n', ' ') for cell in table.rows[0].cells]
                        header_line = "| " + " | ".join(headers) + " |"
                        separator_line = "| " + " | ".join(["---"] * len(headers)) + " |"
                        
                        md_lines.append(header_line)
                        md_lines.append(separator_line)

                        # สร้าง Data Rows
                        for row in table.rows[1:]:
                            cells = [cell.text.strip().replace('\n', ' ') for cell in row.cells]
                            row_line = "| " + " | ".join(cells) + " |"
                            md_lines.append(row_line)
                        
                        md_lines.append("\n")

                full_markdown = "\n\n".join(md_lines)

                # 4. Create New Data
                new_metadata = doc.data.copy()
                # ลบ text binary เก่า (ถ้ามี)
                if "text" in new_metadata:
                    del new_metadata["text"]
                
                new_metadata["doc_extension"] = "docx (converted)"
                
                new_doc = Data(
                    text=full_markdown,
                    data=new_metadata
                )
                converted_docs.append(new_doc)
                self.log(f"Converted {file_path} to Markdown.")

            except Exception as e:
                self.log(f"Error converting {file_path}: {e}")
                converted_docs.append(doc) # ส่งตัวเดิมไปถ้า error

        self.status = f"Converted {len(converted_docs)} docs."
        return converted_docs

                "py: code, sql: code, ts: code, go: code, "
                "csv: spreadsheet, xlsx: spreadsheet"

        ),
    ]

        Output(display_name="Enriched Data", name="output_data", method="process_data"),
    ]

        # --- 1. Parse configs ---
        # Parse Extension Mapping
        ext_map = {}
        try:
            for p in self.ext_mapping.split(','):
                if ':' in p:
                    k, v = p.split(':', 1)
                    ext_map[k.strip().lower()] = v.strip().lower()
        except: pass

        # Parse Folder Mapping (ใหม่)
        folder_map = {}
        try:
            for p in self.folder_mapping.split(','):
                if ':' in p:
                    k, v = p.split(':', 1)
                    # เก็บเป็น k: RAG DEV, v: Developer
                    folder_map[k.strip()] = v.strip()
        except: pass

        # --- 2. Process Data ---
        input_list = self.input_data if isinstance(self.input_data, list) else [self.input_data]
        final_docs = []

            # Handle Nested Structure

                items_to_process = doc.data["results"]
            else:

                department = "General" # ค่า Default

                        if folder_key in file_path:
                            department = dept_name
                            break # เจอแล้วหยุดเลย

                # Update Metadata
                new_metadata["doc_extension"] = extension
                new_metadata["route_key"] = route_key
                new_metadata["department"] = department # ได้ค่าจาก Folder Mapping แล้ว

                # Create Data Object
                new_data = Data(
                    text=text_content, 
                    data=new_metadata
                )
                final_docs.append(new_data)

        self.status = f"Processed {len(final_docs)} docs. Depts: {set(d.data['department'] for d in final_docs)}"

from langflow.custom import Component
from langflow.io import DataInput, Output, MessageTextInput, BoolInput
from langflow.schema import Data
from langchain_text_splitters import MarkdownHeaderTextSplitter

class MarkdownHeaderSplitter(Component):
    display_name = "Markdown Header Splitter"
    description = "Splits markdown text by headers (H1, H2, H3) handling nested 'results' structure."
    icon = "Markdown"
    name = "MarkdownHeaderSplitter"

    inputs = [
        DataInput(
            name="input_data",
            display_name="Input Data",
            info="The data containing 'results' list or direct text.",
            required=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="headers_map",
            display_name="Headers to Split On",
            info="Example: #: H1, ##: H2, ###: H3",
            value="#: H1, ##: H2, ###: H3",
            tool_mode=True,
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="strip_headers",
            display_name="Strip Headers",
            value=False,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Split Data", name="output_data", method="split_markdown"),
    ]

    def split_markdown(self) -> list[Data]:
        # 1. Parse Headers Config
        headers_to_split_on = []
        try:
            raw_headers = self.headers_map.split(",")
            for item in raw_headers:
                if ":" in item:
                    key, val = item.split(":", 1)
                    headers_to_split_on.append((key.strip(), val.strip()))
        except Exception:
            headers_to_split_on = [("#", "Header 1"), ("##", "Header 2"), ("###", "Header 3")]

        markdown_splitter = MarkdownHeaderTextSplitter(
            headers_to_split_on=headers_to_split_on,
            strip_headers=self.strip_headers
        )

        final_docs = []
        
        # แปลง input ให้เป็น list เสมอ
        input_list = self.input_data if isinstance(self.input_data, list) else [self.input_data]

        for doc in input_list:
            # --- ส่วนที่แก้ไข (FIXED LOGIC) ---
            
            # เตรียมรายการข้อมูลที่จะนำมา Split
            items_to_process = []
            
            # กรณี 1: โครงสร้างแบบที่คุณส่งมา (มี key "results" เป็น list)
            if isinstance(doc.data, dict) and "results" in doc.data and isinstance(doc.data["results"], list):
                items_to_process = doc.data["results"] # ดึง list ข้างในออกมา
            
            # กรณี 2: โครงสร้างปกติ (ไม่มี results)
            elif isinstance(doc.data, dict):
                items_to_process = [doc.data] # ใช้ data ก้อนนั้นเลย
            
            # เริ่มวนลูปข้อมูลจริงๆ
            for item in items_to_process:
                # หา text ให้เจอ ไม่ว่าจะชื่อ 'text' หรือ 'page_content'
                text_content = item.get("text") or item.get("page_content")
                
                if not text_content:
                    continue # ถ้าไม่มี text ก็ข้าม

                # ทำการ Split Text
                splits = markdown_splitter.split_text(text_content)

                # สร้าง Output Data
                for split in splits:
                    # Copy Metadata เดิมมา (เช่น file_path)
                    combined_metadata = item.copy()
                    
                    # ลบ text ก้อนใหญ่ทิ้งไป เพื่อไม่ให้หนัก
                    combined_metadata.pop("text", None)
                    combined_metadata.pop("page_content", None)
                    
                    # เพิ่ม Metadata ใหม่จาก Header (H1, H2)
                    combined_metadata.update(split.metadata)

                    # สร้าง Data object ใหม่
                    new_data = Data(
                        text=split.page_content,
                        data=combined_metadata
                    )
                    final_docs.append(new_data)
                    
        self.status = final_docs
        return final_docs

            required=True,

        ),
    ]

from langflow.base.data.utils import TEXT_FILE_TYPES, parallel_load_data, parse_text_file_to_data, retrieve_file_paths
from langflow.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from langflow.io import BoolInput, IntInput, MessageTextInput, MultiselectInput
from langflow.schema.data import Data

        MessageTextInput(

        ),
        MultiselectInput(
            name="types",
            display_name="File Types",
            info="File types to load. Select one or more types or leave empty to load all supported types.",
            options=TEXT_FILE_TYPES,
            value=[],
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="depth",
            display_name="Depth",
            info="Depth to search for files.",
            value=0,
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="max_concurrency",
            display_name="Max Concurrency",
            advanced=True,
            info="Maximum concurrency for loading files.",
            value=2,
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="load_hidden",
            display_name="Load Hidden",
            advanced=True,
            info="If true, hidden files will be loaded.",
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="recursive",
            display_name="Recursive",
            advanced=True,
            info="If true, the search will be recursive.",
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="silent_errors",
            display_name="Silent Errors",
            advanced=True,
            info="If true, errors will not raise an exception.",
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="use_multithreading",
            display_name="Use Multithreading",
            advanced=True,
            info="If true, multithreading will be used.",
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Loaded Files", name="dataframe", method="as_dataframe"),
    ]

    def load_directory(self) -> list[Data]:
        path = self.path
        types = self.types
        depth = self.depth
        max_concurrency = self.max_concurrency
        load_hidden = self.load_hidden
        recursive = self.recursive
        silent_errors = self.silent_errors
        use_multithreading = self.use_multithreading

        resolved_path = self.resolve_path(path)

        # If no types are specified, use all supported types
        if not types:
            types = TEXT_FILE_TYPES

        # Check if all specified types are valid
        invalid_types = [t for t in types if t not in TEXT_FILE_TYPES]
        if invalid_types:
            msg = f"Invalid file types specified: {invalid_types}. Valid types are: {TEXT_FILE_TYPES}"
            raise ValueError(msg)

        valid_types = types

        file_paths = retrieve_file_paths(
            resolved_path, load_hidden=load_hidden, recursive=recursive, depth=depth, types=valid_types
        )

        loaded_data = []
        if use_multithreading:
            loaded_data = parallel_load_data(file_paths, silent_errors=silent_errors, max_concurrency=max_concurrency)
        else:
            loaded_data = [parse_text_file_to_data(file_path, silent_errors=silent_errors) for file_path in file_paths]

        valid_data = [x for x in loaded_data if x is not None and isinstance(x, Data)]
        self.status = valid_data
        return valid_data

    def as_dataframe(self) -> DataFrame:
        return DataFrame(self.load_directory())

from typing import Any

from langflow.custom import Component
from langflow.io import HandleInput, Output, TabInput
from langflow.schema import Data, DataFrame, Message


def convert_to_message(v) -> Message:
    """Convert input to Message type.

    Args:
        v: Input to convert (Message, Data, DataFrame, or dict)

    Returns:
        Message: Converted Message object
    """
    return v if isinstance(v, Message) else v.to_message()


def convert_to_data(v: DataFrame | Data | Message | dict) -> Data:
    """Convert input to Data type.

    Args:
        v: Input to convert (Message, Data, DataFrame, or dict)

    Returns:
        Data: Converted Data object
    """
    if isinstance(v, dict):
        return Data(v)
    if isinstance(v, Message):
        return v.to_data()
    return v if isinstance(v, Data) else v.to_data()


def convert_to_dataframe(v: DataFrame | Data | Message | dict) -> DataFrame:
    """Convert input to DataFrame type.

    Args:
        v: Input to convert (Message, Data, DataFrame, or dict)

    Returns:
        DataFrame: Converted DataFrame object
    """
    if isinstance(v, dict):
        return DataFrame([v])
    return v if isinstance(v, DataFrame) else v.to_dataframe()


class TypeConverterComponent(Component):
    display_name = "Type Convert"
    description = "Convert between different types (Message, Data, DataFrame)"
    documentation: str = "https://docs.langflow.org/components-processing#type-convert"
    icon = "repeat"

    inputs = [
        HandleInput(
            name="input_data",
            display_name="Input",
            input_types=["Message", "Data", "DataFrame"],
            info="Accept Message, Data or DataFrame as input",
            required=True,
        ),
        TabInput(
            name="output_type",
            display_name="Output Type",
            options=["Message", "Data", "DataFrame"],
            info="Select the desired output data type",
            real_time_refresh=True,
            value="Message",
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(
            display_name="Message Output",
            name="message_output",
            method="convert_to_message",
        )
    ]

    def update_outputs(self, frontend_node: dict, field_name: str, field_value: Any) -> dict:
        """Dynamically show only the relevant output based on the selected output type."""
        if field_name == "output_type":
            # Start with empty outputs
            frontend_node["outputs"] = []

            # Add only the selected output type
            if field_value == "Message":
                frontend_node["outputs"].append(
                    Output(
                        display_name="Message Output",
                        name="message_output",
                        method="convert_to_message",
                    ).to_dict()
                )
            elif field_value == "Data":
                frontend_node["outputs"].append(
                    Output(
                        display_name="Data Output",
                        name="data_output",
                        method="convert_to_data",
                    ).to_dict()
                )
            elif field_value == "DataFrame":
                frontend_node["outputs"].append(
                    Output(
                        display_name="DataFrame Output",
                        name="dataframe_output",
                        method="convert_to_dataframe",
                    ).to_dict()
                )

        return frontend_node

    def convert_to_message(self) -> Message:
        """Convert input to Message type."""
        input_value = self.input_data[0] if isinstance(self.input_data, list) else self.input_data

        # Handle string input by converting to Message first
        if isinstance(input_value, str):
            input_value = Message(text=input_value)

        result = convert_to_message(input_value)
        self.status = result
        return result

    def convert_to_data(self) -> Data:
        """Convert input to Data type."""
        input_value = self.input_data[0] if isinstance(self.input_data, list) else self.input_data

        # Handle string input by converting to Message first
        if isinstance(input_value, str):
            input_value = Message(text=input_value)

        result = convert_to_data(input_value)
        self.status = result
        return result

    def convert_to_dataframe(self) -> DataFrame:
        """Convert input to DataFrame type."""
        input_value = self.input_data[0] if isinstance(self.input_data, list) else self.input_data

        # Handle string input by converting to Message first
        if isinstance(input_value, str):
            input_value = Message(text=input_value)

        result = convert_to_dataframe(input_value)
        self.status = result
        return result

            if data and isinstance(data, Data):

        Output(display_name="Spreadsheet Route", name="spreadsheet_out", method="get_spreadsheet"),
        Output(display_name="Text Route", name="text_out", method="get_text"),
    ]

    def _get_mapping(self):
        """
        💎 HARDCODED MAPPING: ฝังไว้ตรงนี้ ชัวร์ที่สุด ไม่ต้องกลัวพิมพ์ผิดใน UI 💎
        """
        return {
            # --- Markdown Route ---
            "md": "markdown",
            "docx": "markdown",
            "doc": "markdown",
            
            # --- Code Route (ตัวเจ้าปัญหา) ---
            "py": "code",
            "ts": "code",
            "tsx": "code",
            "js": "code",
            "jsx": "code",
            "go": "code",
            "cs": "code",
            "sql": "code",
            "json": "code",
            "java": "code",
            "c": "code",
            "cpp": "code",
            "rb": "code",
            "php": "code",
            
            # --- Spreadsheet Route ---
            "csv": "spreadsheet",
            "xlsx": "spreadsheet",
            "xls": "spreadsheet",
            
            # --- Text Route ---
            "txt": "text",
            "log": "text"
        }

    def _route_data(self) -> dict:
        # 1. Load Hardcoded Map
        ext_map = self._get_mapping()
        
        # Log เพื่อยืนยันว่าโหลด Map มาครบ
        self.log(f"🗺️ Using Hardcoded Map ({len(ext_map)} keys)")

        # 2. Parse Folder Mapping (จาก UI)
        folder_map = {}
        try:
            mapping_str = self.folder_mapping.replace('\n', ',')
            for p in mapping_str.split(','):
                if ':' in p:
                    k, v = p.split(':', 1)
                    folder_map[k.strip()] = v.strip()
        except: pass

        # 3. เตรียมถัง (Buckets)
        buckets = {
            "markdown": [],
            "code": [],
            "spreadsheet": [],
            "text": []
        }

        input_list = self.input_data if isinstance(self.input_data, list) else [self.input_data]
        
        leak_count = 0

        for i, doc in enumerate(input_list):
            items = doc.data.get("results", [doc.data]) if isinstance(doc.data, dict) else [doc.data]
            
            for item in items:
                new_metadata = item.copy() if isinstance(item, dict) else {}
                file_path = new_metadata.get("file_path") or new_metadata.get("source", "")
                text_content = new_metadata.get("text") or new_metadata.get("page_content", "")
                
                # A. Extension Logic
                extension = "unknown"
                if file_path:
                    _, ext = os.path.splitext(file_path)
                    extension = ext.lstrip('.').lower()

                # B. Routing Logic
                target_route = ext_map.get(extension, "text") # Default -> text
                
                # Check Bucket Exists
                final_route = "text"
                if target_route in buckets:
                    final_route = target_route
                
                # 🚨 Debug Leak: ถ้าไม่ใช่ txt แต่ลง Text ให้ฟ้อง
                if final_route == "text" and extension != "txt" and extension != "unknown":
                    self.log(f"⚠️ LEAK: '{extension}' routed to TEXT (Map check: {extension in ext_map})")
                    leak_count += 1

                # C. Department Logic
                department = "General"
                if file_path:
                    for folder_key, dept_name in folder_map.items():
                        if folder_key in file_path:
                            department = dept_name
                            break
                
                # Enrich
                new_metadata["doc_extension"] = extension
                new_metadata["route_key"] = final_route
                new_metadata["department"] = department

                new_data = Data(text=text_content, data=new_metadata)

                buckets[final_route].append(new_data)
        
        # Log Summary
        summary = {k: len(v) for k, v in buckets.items()}
        self.log(f"✅ Routing Summary: {summary} | Leaks: {leak_count}")
        
        return buckets

    def get_markdown(self) -> list[Data]:
        return self._route_data()['markdown']

    def get_code(self) -> list[Data]:
        return self._route_data()['code']

    def get_spreadsheet(self) -> list[Data]:
        return self._route_data()['spreadsheet']

    def get_text(self) -> list[Data]:
        return self._route_data()['text']

from langflow.io import BoolInput, IntInput, MessageTextInput, MultiselectInput
from langflow.schema.data import Data
from langflow.schema.dataframe import DataFrame
from langflow.template.field.base import Output
import os

class UnlockedDirectoryLoader(Component):
    display_name = "Directory (Unlocked V3)"
    description = "Universal Loader: Handles Text, Code, Spreadsheet, and Docs safely."
    icon = "folder-open"
    name = "UnlockedDirectory"

    # 1. รายชื่อนามสกุลไฟล์ทั้งหมดที่เราอยากให้หาเจอ (Whitelist)
    CUSTOM_FILE_TYPES = [
        "md", "txt",                    # Text / Docs
        "py", "ts", "tsx", "js", "jsx", # Code
        "go", "cs", "java",             # Code (Compiled)
        "sql", "json", "yaml", "xml",   # Data / Config
        "csv", "xlsx", "xls",           # Spreadsheet
        "docx", "doc", "pdf", "html"    # Documents
    ]

    # 2. นามสกุลที่เป็น Binary (ห้ามอ่านเป็น Text ให้ส่งแค่ Path)
    # หมายเหตุ: .docx และ .xlsx ต้องอยู่นี้ เพราะต้องใช้ Library พิเศษอ่าน
    BINARY_EXTENSIONS = {
        '.xlsx', '.xls', 
        '.docx', '.doc', 
        '.pdf', '.zip', 
        '.png', '.jpg', '.jpeg'
    }

    inputs = [
        MessageTextInput(
            name="path",
            display_name="Path",
            info="Path to the directory to load files from.",
            value="", # ตั้ง Default ให้ตรงกับ Folder งานจริง
            tool_mode=True,
        ),
        MultiselectInput(
            name="types",
            display_name="File Types",
            info="Select file types to load.",
            options=CUSTOM_FILE_TYPES,
            value=[], # ถ้าว่าง = เอาหมดทุกประเภทใน list ข้างบน
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="depth",
            display_name="Depth",
            info="Depth to search for files.",
            value=0,
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="max_concurrency",
            display_name="Max Concurrency",
            value=2,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="load_hidden",
            display_name="Load Hidden",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="recursive",
            display_name="Recursive",
            value=True,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="silent_errors",
            display_name="Silent Errors",
            value=True,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="use_multithreading",
            display_name="Use Multithreading",
            value=False, # แนะนำ False เพื่อความเสถียรในการ debug
            advanced=True,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Loaded Files", name="dataframe", method="as_dataframe"),
    ]

    def safe_load_file(self, file_path: str) -> Data:
        """
        Logic แยกแยะ: อ่าน Text หรือ ส่งผ่าน Binary
        """
        filename, ext = os.path.splitext(file_path)
        ext = ext.lower()

        # กรณี 1: เจอไฟล์ Binary (xlsx, docx, pdf) -> ห้ามอ่าน Text!
        if ext in self.BINARY_EXTENSIONS:
            # ส่ง Data ว่างๆ ที่มี Metadata เป็น Path
            return Data(
                text="", 
                data={"file_path": file_path, "source": file_path}
            )

        # กรณี 2: ไฟล์ Text ทั่วไป (md, py, txt, csv) -> อ่านตามปกติ
        try:
            return parse_text_file_to_data(file_path, silent_errors=self.silent_errors)
        except Exception as e:
            if not self.silent_errors:
                raise e
            # ถ้าอ่านไม่ได้จริงๆ ให้ส่งเป็น Binary Mode (เผื่อไว้)
            return Data(
                text="",
                data={"file_path": file_path, "source": file_path, "error": str(e)}
            )

    def load_directory(self) -> list[Data]:
        path = self.path
        types = self.types
        if not types:
            types = self.CUSTOM_FILE_TYPES

        # 1. ค้นหาไฟล์
        file_paths = retrieve_file_paths(
            self.resolve_path(path), 
            load_hidden=self.load_hidden, 
            recursive=self.recursive, 
            depth=self.depth, 
            types=types
        )

        loaded_data = []
        
        # 2. อ่านไฟล์ทีละไฟล์
        for file_path in file_paths:
            data = self.safe_load_file(str(file_path))
            if data and isinstance(data, Data):
                loaded_data.append(data)

        self.status = f"Loaded {len(loaded_data)} files."
        return loaded_data

    def as_dataframe(self) -> DataFrame:
        return DataFrame(self.load_directory())

    icon = "save"
    name = "DataSaver"

    inputs = [
        DataInput(
            name="input_data",
            display_name="Input Data",
            info="Data coming from Splitters (Markdown or Recursive).",
            required=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="file_path",
            display_name="File Path",
            info="Path to save the file (e.g., /app/output_chunks.jsonl or ./output.json)",
            value="output_chunks.jsonl",
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="format_type",
            display_name="Format",
            options=["JSONL", "JSON"],
            value="JSONL",
            info="JSONL is best for large datasets (one object per line). JSON is a standard list.",
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="append_mode",
            display_name="Append to File",
            info="If True, adds to the existing file. If False, overwrites it.",
            value=False,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Passed Data", name="output_data", method="save_data"),
    ]

        # 1. แปลง Input ให้เป็น List เสมอ
        data_list = self.input_data if isinstance(self.input_data, list) else [self.input_data]
        
        # 2. เตรียมข้อมูลที่จะบันทึก (แปลง Data Object -> Dict)

        for doc in data_list:
            # ดึง text และ metadata
            # พยายามหา text จาก key ต่างๆ
            text_content = ""
            if hasattr(doc, 'text') and doc.text:
                text_content = doc.text
            elif isinstance(doc.data, dict):
                text_content = doc.data.get("text") or doc.data.get("page_content", "")
            
            # Metadata
            metadata = doc.data if doc.data else {}
            
            # สร้าง Dict สำหรับบันทึก
            record = {
                "text": text_content,
                "metadata": metadata
            }
            records_to_save.append(record)

        # 3. บันทึกลงไฟล์
        mode = "a" if self.append_mode else "w"
        encoding = "utf-8"
        
        try:
            # สร้าง Folder ถ้ายังไม่มี
            folder = os.path.dirname(self.file_path)
            if folder and not os.path.exists(folder):
                os.makedirs(folder)

            with open(self.file_path, mode, encoding=encoding) as f:
                if self.format_type == "JSONL":
                    for record in records_to_save:
                        f.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
                
                elif self.format_type == "JSON":
                    # กรณี JSON ปกติ ถ้า Append mode จะยุ่งยากหน่อย (ต้องอ่านของเก่ามาแก้)
                    # เพื่อความง่ายใน POC ถ้าเป็น JSON เราจะเขียนทับ หรือถ้า Append จะเขียนต่อแบบ text (ซึ่งอาจทำให้ JSON invalid)
                    # ดังนั้นแนะนำ JSONL ดีกว่า
                    if self.append_mode and os.path.exists(self.file_path) and os.path.getsize(self.file_path) > 0:
                         # Warning: Appending to JSON array strictly is hard via stream, 
                         # just writing generic dump here.
                         f.write("\n" + json.dumps(records_to_save, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
                    else:
                        json.dump(records_to_save, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

            self.status = f"Successfully saved {len(records_to_save)} records to {self.file_path}"
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.status = f"Error saving file: {str(e)}"
            # ถึง save ไม่ได้ ก็ส่ง data ต่อไปเผื่อ node อื่นจะใช้
            return data_list

        # ส่ง Data เดิมออกไป เพื่อให้ Flow ไหลต่อได้ (เช่น ส่งไป ChromaDB ต่อ)
        return data_list

from langflow.schema import Data
import json
import os

class DataSaverComponent(Component):
    display_name = "Data Saver (File)"
    description = "Saves processed chunks (text & metadata) to a local file for inspection."
    icon = "save"
    name = "DataSaver"

    inputs = [
        DataInput(
            name="input_data",
            display_name="Input Data",
            info="Data coming from Splitters (Markdown or Recursive).",
            required=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="file_path",
            display_name="File Path",
            info="Path to save the file (e.g., /app/output_chunks.jsonl or ./output.json)",
            value="output_chunks.jsonl",
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="format_type",
            display_name="Format",
            options=["JSONL", "JSON"],
            value="JSONL",
            info="JSONL is best for large datasets (one object per line). JSON is a standard list.",
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="append_mode",
            display_name="Append to File",
            info="If True, adds to the existing file. If False, overwrites it.",
            value=False,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Passed Data", name="output_data", method="save_data"),
    ]

    def save_data(self) -> list[Data]:
        # 1. แปลง Input ให้เป็น List เสมอ
        data_list = self.input_data if isinstance(self.input_data, list) else [self.input_data]
        
        # 2. เตรียมข้อมูลที่จะบันทึก (แปลง Data Object -> Dict)
        records_to_save = []
        for doc in data_list:
            # ดึง text และ metadata
            # พยายามหา text จาก key ต่างๆ
            text_content = ""
            if hasattr(doc, 'text') and doc.text:
                text_content = doc.text
            elif isinstance(doc.data, dict):
                text_content = doc.data.get("text") or doc.data.get("page_content", "")
            
            # Metadata
            metadata = doc.data if doc.data else {}
            
            # สร้าง Dict สำหรับบันทึก
            record = {
                "text": text_content,
                "metadata": metadata
            }
            records_to_save.append(record)

        # 3. บันทึกลงไฟล์
        mode = "a" if self.append_mode else "w"
        encoding = "utf-8"
        
        try:
            # สร้าง Folder ถ้ายังไม่มี
            folder = os.path.dirname(self.file_path)
            if folder and not os.path.exists(folder):
                os.makedirs(folder)

            with open(self.file_path, mode, encoding=encoding) as f:
                if self.format_type == "JSONL":
                    for record in records_to_save:
                        f.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
                
                elif self.format_type == "JSON":
                    # กรณี JSON ปกติ ถ้า Append mode จะยุ่งยากหน่อย (ต้องอ่านของเก่ามาแก้)
                    # เพื่อความง่ายใน POC ถ้าเป็น JSON เราจะเขียนทับ หรือถ้า Append จะเขียนต่อแบบ text (ซึ่งอาจทำให้ JSON invalid)
                    # ดังนั้นแนะนำ JSONL ดีกว่า
                    if self.append_mode and os.path.exists(self.file_path) and os.path.getsize(self.file_path) > 0:
                         # Warning: Appending to JSON array strictly is hard via stream, 
                         # just writing generic dump here.
                         f.write("\n" + json.dumps(records_to_save, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
                    else:
                        json.dump(records_to_save, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

            self.status = f"Successfully saved {len(records_to_save)} records to {self.file_path}"
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.status = f"Error saving file: {str(e)}"
            # ถึง save ไม่ได้ ก็ส่ง data ต่อไปเผื่อ node อื่นจะใช้
            return data_list

        # ส่ง Data เดิมออกไป เพื่อให้ Flow ไหลต่อได้ (เช่น ส่งไป ChromaDB ต่อ)
        return data_list
